title: Walsh characters have bounded multiplicative degree
statement: For every subset $S \subseteq [n]$ and every integer $d \ge 1$, the Walsh--Fourier character $\chi_S$ has degree $\le d$: for every base point $x \in \{0,1\}^n$ and all direction vectors $h_1, \ldots, h_{d+1} \in \{0,1\}^n$, the $(d{+}1)$-fold Gowers product satisfies $\mathrm{GP}(\chi_S,\, d{+}1,\, x,\, h_1, \ldots, h_{d+1}) = 1$.
replaced: For every $S \subseteq [n]$ and $d \ge 1$, the character $\chi_S$ has degree $\le d$.
